summary: First instrumentation slice for #2123: slow SQLite writer batches and long writer waits export independent traces with begin, operation, finalizer, commit and post-commit timings, same-database checkpoint overlap, a bounded slowest-operation origin and the writer holder observed at enqueue. Reconcile passes export named phase children, including stage operations and fault snapshots.

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: Published schemas, operations and contract digest are unchanged; trace-only attributes and span names are added when trace export is enabled.

rules.detail: No transaction, reconcile, lifecycle or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: No client or peer protocol change. Writer origins use normalized request routes and a fixed maintenance-task whitelist independently of the profiler; unknown origins are reported as other.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or additional startup work.

manual.detail: Instrumentation is off by default. Optionally set ST3_STORAGE_PHASE_SPANS=1 on the daemon alongside trace export to enable writer roots and reconcile phase children; ST3_PROFILE_DIR is not needed. Holder labels cover batched operations and foreground, background and fence loans; none means idle at enqueue. Member stop/live timings are count, total_ms and max_ms attributes on the members phase, not per-member spans. Checkpoint overlap measures explicit in-process checkpoints on the same database, not external-process or SQLite auto-checkpoints, and is not additive with the other phase timings.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
